authoritative_for: Platter owns its canonical SQLite library: captured inputs, preparation runs, immutable content artifacts, explicit job eligibility, frozen editions, recorded delivery outcomes, settings and maintenance holds. Editions share one model; retained-material selection is an operation. Platter also owns disposable Ashby board files under the runtime root, shared by preparation and preview for less than 14 days.

The product owns its schema-two Clockwork schedule definition and declares halt-until-approved. Clockwork owns failure-policy enforcement and retained scheduling incidents; product domain recovery remains separate.
not_authoritative_for: Cast owns discovery records. CRM owns career entries. Employer endpoints supply posting text. Nucleus owns execution. Email and Resend own submission acceptance. Gmail owns final receipt. Clockwork owns scheduled activation, durable scheduling halts, explicit continuation, incident notification and runtime process history.

covers: All Platter initialization, preparation, authorized daily and URL-selected preparation and delivery, ordinary and retained-material edition selection, explicit send, eligibility, export, local status, readiness, product-owned schedule-definition generation, migration and maintained installation outcomes.
excludes: Help/version, Clockwork activation management, automatic application submission, employer contact, CRM writes and final inbox delivery observation.

shared_access_and_trust: The current-user CLI operates private state. Models receive only captured source material and narrow requester tools. The installer publishes only Platter-owned command and provider selectors through Cell coordinated maintenance. A source bundle alone establishes neither an installed command nor send authority.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Original resume, captured CRM entries, posting text, model inputs/results, evidence references, PDFs, editions and send outcomes are private retained data. Nucleus/model processing receives career material; explicit send discloses the brief and resume attachments to Email, Resend and Gmail.
Clockwork incident notification discloses bounded operational metadata to the fixed Email recipient. Product content and private failure output are not copied into the notification.

CLI dispatch separately attempts a metadata-only Chancery usage append (system, command, optional Codex thread and observation time). Recording errors preserve product results; no arguments or output are retained. Registration is a separate --register-usage installation step.
compatibility_and_retirement: Preparation contract 7 adds independent editorial review for new runs. Installation contract 5 supports private schema 3, preserving legacy inputs, exact requests and artifacts. Existing runs retain their legacy workflow. Older binaries cannot operate schema three. Cast collection contract 5 and Clockwork schedule contract 3 remain required.
operational_limits: Each edition contains up to three new ready packets; run-ad-hoc selects exactly one. There is no candidate or token budget. Jobs use gpt-5.6-sol at max effort. Run commands need applicable send authorization and do not resend accepted or uncertain editions. Activation is managed separately through Clockwork; stored 09:00 fields do not schedule work. Check source, runtime and rendering readiness separately.
